title: Ordinary tensor square for composite module pullback
statement:
Let R,S,T be sheaves of commutative rings on three small sites. Use the categories of module sheaves, ringed pullbacks f:R to S, g:S to T, h:R to T, their normalized comparisons kf,kg,kh, and the normalized composite presentation a of [def-pur-cochain-tensor-coherence-data]. Write F=f.L, G=g.L, H=h.L, and let c:H to F composed with G be the natural isomorphism compositionModule(f,g,h,a.rightModules), obtained from the composite adjunction [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. For every pair of R-module sheaves M,N, the following equality of T-linear module-sheaf morphisms holds:
$$k_h(M,N)\,;\,(c_M\otimes c_N)=c_{M\otimes_R N}\,;\,G(k_f(M,N))\,;\,k_g(FM,FN).$$
Here a semicolon denotes composition in order of application, and k denotes the forward normalized module tensor isomorphism from the pullback of a tensor product to the tensor product of the two pullbacks. No complexes, boundedness, flatness, or nonzero-ring assumption is involved.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 03EL (sites-modules.tex) and 0D6D; explicit refinement of step 5 of lem-pur-cochain-pullback-tensor-coherence.

proof.text: Construct a comparison on h by transporting the composite of kf and kg along compositionModule on the source tensor and both target factors. Naturality is the composite of the two naturality equations and the conjugate naturality. For the pure formula apply the normalized scalarAssociation field of a, generator naturality for g, and the two pure formulas. Tensoring the two inverse conjugates cancels the scalar associations on the generators. Uniqueness of the normalized comparison on h identifies this constructed comparison with kh. Postcompose by the tensor of the two forward conjugates and cancel each inverse to obtain the equation.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof by constructing the composite normalized comparison and applying its uniqueness.

lean.statement:
theorem cochainModuleTensorComposition
    {E : Type uE} [Category.{vE} E] [EssentiallySmall.{w} E]
    {H : GrothendieckTopology E}
    [H.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
    {T : Sheaf H CommRingCat.{w}} (f : RingedPullback R S)
    (g : RingedPullback S T) (h : RingedPullback R T)
    (kf : Comparison f) (kg : Comparison g) (kh : Comparison h)
    (a : CompositePresentation f g h kf kg kh)
 :
    ∀ M N : Modules R,
      (kh.mu M N).hom ≫
          ((compositionModule f g h a.rightModules).hom.app M ⊗ₘ
            (compositionModule f g h a.rightModules).hom.app N) =
        (compositionModule f g h a.rightModules).hom.app (M ⊗ N) ≫
          g.L.map (kf.mu M N).hom ≫ (kg.mu (f.L.obj M) (f.L.obj N)).hom
